messages:
olivia: Heads-up — PR #4123 needs final sign-off before tomorrow's merge window. It's a combo: tone/terminology enforcement + Python SDK snippet parity. Docs preview up but has some failing checks.

docs-ci: Preview available: https://zeus.redwood/docs/previews/4123 — 2 failing checks (link-check, markdown-lint). See CI console.

jamal: @olivia can you list the critical nits? i'll triage.

olivia: Mostly: (1) inconsistent use of "model name" vs "model family"; (2) python example uses old SDK `Client.run` vs new `Client.generate`; (3) one absolute staging link that 404s. migration guide formatting has a couple header-level issues.

maya: i'm +1 on using "model family" as canonical (see style guide §Terminology). use "model version" when referring to specific weights.

kevin: i'll take the SDK snippet. which examples need changing?

olivia: the python examples at the bottom and the migration snippet under /docs/guides/migrations/dedicated.md#python-snippets

kevin: ok. i'll replace `Client.run(..)` -> `Client.generate(..)` and push a tiny patch. snippet i'll use: 

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-large", prompt="Summarize the design doc in one paragraph")
print(resp.text)
```

jamal: note to reviewers: please focus on terminology consistency and SDK snippet parity; avoid bikeshedding micro-phrasing unless it alters meaning. target merge window: 09:00 PST tomorrow. :alarm_clock: 

lexa: i can do a quick pass for formatting + links after kevin's patch. ping me when done.

docs-ci: link-check failed on https://staging.internal.redwood.ai/old-path -> 404 (file: guides/migrations/dedicated.md)

olivia: that staging link should be replaced with relative path `/docs/edge-routing`. @jamal can you swap it or i'll do it if you don't have time.

jamal: replaced with relative link and pushed (commit 1977654335). also fixed trivial markdown-lint nits. :white_check_mark:

kevin: pushed snippet fix (commit 1977654378). added a tiny test to ensure code block renders and language is labelled `python`.

maya: small terminology nit: in the migration guide call out "pin model versions" (not "pin models") — i've left an inline comment on line 84.

olivia: thanks — @maya please approve for terminology. @lexa i'll hand off final formatting to you once CI is green.

docs-ci: build passed (all checks green) — preview updated: https://zeus.redwood/docs/previews/4123

jamal: APPROVED.

maya: approved.

lexa: formatting + links sweep done. ready to merge in next window. :sparkles:

olivia: excellent — merging at 09:00 PST. i'll tag release notes: "docs: migration snippet parity + terminology fixes" :tada:

docs-ci: merge task queued. deploy-bot will announce prod deploy once live.
